description: Test jsonb_each in FROM position, which expands into two real columns: key (text) and value (jsonb)
name: jsonb_each_from
query_sql:
-- @name GetDocEntries
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, kv.key, kv.value FROM documents, jsonb_each(data) AS kv
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE documents (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, data JSONB NOT NULL, metadata JSONB);
